configuration.generation: offline deterministic extractive adapter; not OpenAI or production generation
configuration.prompt_configuration_reference: No prompt executed; generation adapter's default Prompt C interface marker only. Production prompt text was not modified.
configuration.storage: temporary isolated Chroma; no production SQLite/Chroma writes

interpretation: Deterministic lexical heuristics and a local mock/extractive generator are instrumentation checks, not semantic ground truth. Controlled and end-to-end metrics are separate and must not be collapsed into a single score.
limitations: All 12 items and both PDFs are synthetic development fixtures, not official policy.
The offline embedding substitute is not text-embedding-3-small; real production embedding performance is unverified.
The mock generator is not the configured OpenAI generator; production generation quality is untested.
Claim support and correctness use explicit lexical heuristics and are not semantic entailment judgments.
No human evaluator or LLM-as-judge was used; semantic correctness and faithfulness remain unverified.
The dataset is small and has no populated held-out split.
